up: Retrieve molecules reported in the document with ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL1821609'. For each molecule, return its ChEMBL ID, preferred name, maximum clinical trial phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES. Order the results by ChEMBL ID. Do not apply any row limits.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id,
  md.pref_name,
  md.max_phase,
  md.molecule_type,
  cs.canonical_smiles
FROM docs d
JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1821609'
ORDER BY md.chembl_id
